service.name: device-control
service.description: Control owner-authorized physical and virtual devices through pluggable transports, capability-derived actions, durable identity, auditable sessions, and reusable automation flows.

vrooli-bridge.purpose: Device reach plane: node and attached-device registry, per-node scopes, allowlisted dispatch, durable runs, and audit.
vrooli-bridge.degraded_behavior: Every device reports unreachable with 'bridge unavailable' as the reason. No device is assumed present and no verb is dispatched.

ai-gateway.purpose: Provider-neutral inference for ai.* flow steps and the vision rung of the target resolution ladder.
ai-gateway.degraded_behavior: ai.* steps report unavailable naming the missing gateway capability. Flows without ai.* steps run unaffected; this scenario never falls back to a direct provider call.

agent-manager.purpose: Runtime for goal-directed device runs spawned by agent mode.
agent-manager.degraded_behavior: Agent mode reports unavailable. Flow authoring and execution are unaffected.

prompt-manager.purpose: Hosts the operator skill that teaches an agent this scenario's CLI contract.
prompt-manager.degraded_behavior: Agent mode refuses to start rather than improvising without the skill.

browser-automation-studio.purpose: Executes named web-content flows against an attached application WebView for bas.* delegation steps.
browser-automation-studio.degraded_behavior: bas.* steps report unavailable; every other step kind still runs.

audio-tools.purpose: Optional shared voice input and audio output for device-control voice capabilities.
audio-tools.degraded_behavior: Voice input and output report unavailable; device discovery, leases, flows, and non-audio verbs remain unaffected.

scenario-authenticator.purpose: Authenticates the bridge-backed local control connection.
scenario-authenticator.degraded_behavior: Bridge-backed devices report unavailable with an authentication dependency reason; no device verb is dispatched.

evidence.rationale: Retained, redacted device-control captures referenced by completed flow runs.

budget.rationale: Bound retained evidence while preserving audit references; operators can configure a stricter evidence directory policy.

storage.rationale: Device-control owns retained evidence bytes and the SQLite audit metadata; consumers receive references only.
